parameters.query:
SET search_path TO inventario;

SELECT 
    c.nombre                    AS cliente,
    COUNT(v.id)                 AS total_compras,
    COALESCE(SUM(v.total), 0)  AS total_gastado,
    MAX(v.fecha)::DATE          AS ultima_compra,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(v.id) >= 5 THEN 'VIP'
        WHEN COUNT(v.id) >= 3 THEN 'frecuente'
        WHEN COUNT(v.id) >= 1 THEN 'ocasional'
        ELSE 'sin compras'
    END                         AS categoria_cliente
FROM clientes c
LEFT JOIN ventas v ON v.cliente_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.nombre
ORDER BY total_compras DESC, total_gastado DESC;
